# Psalm 67 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. With-stringed-instruments. A-psalm. A-song.

**2** May-God be-gracious to-us and-bless-us; may-He-cause His-face to-shine upon-us. Selah.

**3** That-Your-way may-be-known on-earth, Your-salvation among-all nations.

**4** Let-the-peoples praise-You, O-God; let-all the-peoples praise-You.

**5** Let-the-nations be-glad and-sing-for-joy, for You-judge the-peoples with-equity and-the-nations on-earth You-guide. Selah.

**6** Let-the-peoples praise-You, O-God; let-all the-peoples praise-You.

**7** The-earth has-yielded its-produce; God, our-God, blesses-us.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **67:2**: The language echoes the Aaronic blessing (Num 6:24-26) — but extended to all nations, not just Israel. The priestly blessing goes global.

— EMET
